scenarios.title: Offered pair and pinned receipt
scenarios.expected: The driver forwards v4 → v7 to summary validation. The artifact contains both approved hashes and exactly C17 and C18. A later v4 → v8 offer creates a different artifact. The first receipt still returns the exact v7 summary in fr-CA.

scenarios.title: Withheld offer
scenarios.expected: The regional API supplies no summary pair. The summary HTTP server observes zero generation requests and reads no approved artifacts.

scenarios.title: Changed approved bytes
scenarios.expected: The regional API offers v4 → v7. Summary validation returns HTTP 422 HASH_MISMATCH for the changed bytes, emits no artifact and never calls the grouping fixture.
